question: Where does India rank on the Corruption Perceptions Index as of October 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**93**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the latest Corruption Perceptions Index,** India ranks 96rd out of 180 countries. **
 
• This reflects a slight decline from the previous year,** where India was ranked 85th with a score of 40**. 
 
• The CPI is published annually by **Transparency International and assesses perceived** levels of public sector corruption worldwide.
 
• **A score of 0 indicates a highly corrupt nation**, while a score of 100 signifies a very clean one
 
• **Denmark** ranked as the least corrupt country globally.
 
• **Somalia**, **South Sudan**, and **Syria** were ranked among the most corrupt.
